unresolved_findings.title: Original operation and cleanup deadlines are not enforced by actual guardian path
unresolved_findings.evidence: call/3 always dispatches now+5000; settle starts budget after initial call and each resume again uses fresh call/3 budget. ready/response preserve an outer local timestamp but do not pass it into guardian or check after returned success. Guardian accepts correlated result without checking now against operation.deadline. Guardian state has no original opening/total/cleanup deadline, while finish_session gives fresh now+1000 and teardown has independent 6000ms stop/DOWN waits plus caller waits, so cleanup grace can extend on each stage. The 150ms late-result double only covers an already-delivered timer; it does not exercise resumed call budgets or late result preceding timer handling.
unresolved_findings.impact: A slow call/resume near deadline can return success beyond original budget; independent teardown can wait beyond prescribed cleanup grace. Passing current row count would not qualify unchanged deadline contract.
unresolved_findings.required_change: Create original absolute opening/total/operation/cleanup deadlines at their existing lifecycle boundaries, propagate applicable original deadline through initial call/resume/ready/poll, never recreate full budgets on wakeup. Reject correlated late results using that deadline even before timer dispatch. Stop remains independent; all waits use remaining original cleanup grace and record uncertainty when exhausted. Add actual-helper doubles for repeated resume and successful result received after original deadline, plus stalled stop/task termination past original cleanup grace without completion.

unresolved_findings.title: Cancellation and uncertain cleanup doubles bypass the guardian helpers and miss broken branches
unresolved_findings.evidence: ownership_double manually calls Transport.client/stop_endpoint in independent creator code and computes complete?=result==:ok or writes cleanup_token=retained. It never invokes SessionGuardian.creator/loop/teardown for before-adoption, ACK-before-creator-DOWN, creator-DOWN-before-caller launch, stop error, or abnormal endpoint DOWN. Actual teardown always calls stop_task(state.endpoint), then state.endpoint.pid at485; cancel before descriptor with endpoint=nil is not handled and will fail before confirmed creator cleanup. Adopt handler always ACKs without terminal check. Actual stop-error/abnormal-DOWN path sends a receipt at540 before asserting success at541 and has no explicit cleanup-unconfirmed result branch. Existing manual doubles cannot expose any of these failures or enforce retained uncertainty.
unresolved_findings.impact: 45 named rows include five ownership/cleanup rows that can pass while the selected guardian lifecycle violates the reviewed contract. Reported retained token is a constant diagnostic label, not an exercised completion/uncertainty decision.
unresolved_findings.required_change: Drive the existing actual creator and guardian helpers using deterministic barriers and injectable public endpoint boundary outcomes at all three cancellation boundaries. Exercise real helper branches for stop error, abnormal/missing endpoint DOWN and cleanup expiry; distinguish confirmed cleanup from explicit uncertainty without sending a success-shaped completion receipt first. Handle endpoint=nil/creator-owned allocation during cancellation, terminal adoption races and creator loss. Keep Service completion NOT CLAIMED until UP1; assert helper cleanup outcome/state rather than a handwritten token label. Preserve old double evidence and all original network assertions.
